Procurement of foodgrains for exports
*281. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the grandiose proposal of
Government to allow direct procurement
of foodgrains from the market for exports
has not found favour;
(b) whether this proposal was to go into
operation from April 1, 2004;
(c) if so, to what extent this proposal
has been considered afresh; and
(d) by when, a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Vacancies of teachers in KVS
†*282. CAPTAIN JAI NARAIN
PRASAD NISHAD:
SHRI GHANSHYAM
CHANDRA KHARWAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several posts
of teachers are lying vacant in Kendriya
Vidyalaya Sangathan;
(b) if so, the details thereof as on the
30th June, 2004; and
(c) by when the above vacancies are
likely to be filled up?
Destitute youths and children
*283. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
more than four lakh destitute youths and
children who are roaming on Delhi roads
alone;
(b) whether 60 per cent of them are in
the clutches of 'Evil' elements; and
(c) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken for rescue, shelter and rehabilitation
of such destitutes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Employees’ dues with Public Sector
Enterprises
*284. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the employees' dues
with the Public Sector Enterprises on
account of salary , wages and other
statutory dues as on the 31st March, 2004,
enterprise-wise alongwith the number of
workers employed in each unit; and
(b) the steps taken by Government for
payment of the dues?
Ban on election advertisements and
opinion polls
†*285. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Election
Commission has made some suggestions
with regard to imposing ban on election
advertisements and opinion polls;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) Government's reaction thereto; and
(d) by when Government are likely to
take a decision in this regard?
Subsidy for flower exports
*286. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring down or subsidise air freight on export
of flowers to boost exports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) other steps proposed to boost
export of flowers?
Authentication of certificates
*287. SHRI N.K. PREMACHAN-
DRAN: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the job seekers to Gulf countries from
Kerala are experiencing much difficulty due
to the inordinate delay in attesting
certificates;
(b) whether Government propose to
introduce any remedial measures either by
entrusting the task exclusively to an official
team or by authorizing the State
Government so as to help the job seekers;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
High Court Bench at Madurai
*288. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the High Court Bench at
Madurai is a Full Bench or not;
(b) whether the jurisdiction issue has
been sorted out or not;
(c) the overriding factors behind the
boycott of the Madras High Court
Lawyers; and
(d) the remedial steps taken by
Government?
UNCTAD meeting at Sao Paulo
*289. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that he had led a
delegation of Members of Parliament to

87
the Eleventh Session of United Nations
Conference on Trade and Development at
Sao Paulo in Brazil recently;
(b) if so, the stand taken by Government
on farm subsidies by the United States;
(c) whether the delegation had
impressed upon the need for preferential
treatment for developing countries; and
(d) if so, the details of the outcome of
the conference and how far the same has
been beneficial to the country?

Agri-Export Zone at Vijayawada
1159. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Agri Export Zone at
Vijayawada had been approved by
Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by
when Exports would commence from
Vijayawada Agri Export Zone;
(c) if the answer to part (a) is negative,
the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Memorandum of
Understanding between Union
Government and Government of Andhra
Pradesh had been signed;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Change in external trade policy
1160. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering a significant change in the
country's external trade policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the measures proposed to protect
interests of the domestic industries and
agricultural services against the American
policy of unrestricted support to the
domestic sector which is virtually
eliminating competition from the third
world countries?
Rise in gold imports
1161. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a spurt in gold
imports in view of relaxation of import
norms;
(b) if so, the approximate quantity of
gold imports in first quarter of 2004-05;
and

Gold imports
1162. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the sources from where gold is
imported;
(b) whether imports this year has
surpassed all previous import highs; and
(c) the reasons for rise in prices of
gold inspite of recent relaxation in import
norms?
Tea cultivation in Tripura
1163. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the status of the proposal for
expansion of area under Tea cultivation in
Tripura during the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) whether the required funds were
sanctioned during 2003-04; and
(c) by when the project would be
completed?
Export of spices and cashew
1164. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a slump in exports
of spices and cashew;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to increase the
exports?
Indo-Thailand trade pact
1165. SHRIMATI  AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Thailand have
signed a trade pact;
(b) if so, the features thereof;
(c) whether Agro-industries, automotive
parts and components, electronics,
software would have a significant
investment potential in Thailand;
(d) if so, to what extent, India would
be able to invest in the above mentioned
fields in Thailand; and
(e) whether any agreement has been
signed between the two countries?
Patent Amendment Bill
1166. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have drafted the Patents Amendment Bill;
(b) whether it is designed to meet
Trade related intellectual property
obligation of extending product patents
to pharma and agro-chemical sectors;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what steps Government are taking,
through amending Bill, to simplify
processing of the applications?

Fall in industrial growth
1167. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY :
SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the industrial growth
slipped to 6.2 per cent in May, 2004
which is slower as compared to 6.4 per
cent growth in the same month last year;
(b) if so, the reasons for slow growth
in the industrial secto r; and
(c) the steps being taken to improve
the industrial growth in future?
Indo-China trade
1168. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India-China bilateral trade
has touched $ 10 billion during the current
year;
(b) if so, what was the trade during
the year 2003-04;
(c) whether Government are
considering to improve the trade with
China further during 2004-05; and
(d) if so, the steps being considered in
this regard?
Flower export zones
